messages:
Clara Mendes: Coordinating hybrid onsite for Tomas Rivera on Mon Oct 7. Candidate requests 10:00am-2:00pm PT window with an option to join last interview remotely if travel delayed. Also requested a Spanish sign-language interpreter for part of the day and gluten-free + nut-free lunch. Can we confirm interpreter and travel stipend rules?

Jorge Alvarez: Im available 10:15-11:00 for the product deep-dive. Happy to have the last 30m remote-friendly.

Facilities: We can reserve Room 210 (3rd floor) and Quiet Room D for breaks. For interpreter, do you want them onsite or remote? We can host remote interpreter on a large monitor.

Clara Mendes: Candidate prefers an in-person interpreter if possible, but remote is acceptable as fallback. Please book in-person first. Also needs accessible entrance directions and a greeter.

IT Support: Noted. We'll reserve a Teams room kit for Room 210 and set up a large monitor for the interpreter feed. Also can prepare a loaner Windows laptop (tag W-721) with corp image if needed.

People Ops Bot: Badge request initiated  BR-22111. Visitor parking hold placed. Note: interpreter vendor billing should be attached as EXP-ACCESS-INT.

Clara Mendes: Travel stipend: domestic up to $300 for non-air travel (rideshare/public). If candidate uses personal vehicle, mileage reimbursement applies. Candidate prefers Venmo  payroll?

Payroll: We do not process Venmo. Reimbursements via ACH only. For mileage, use standard IRS rate; for rideshare, submit receipt and code EXP-HIRE-TRAVEL. ACH can be set up once candidate provides bank details post-offer.

Jorge Alvarez: One more note: Tomas studied abroad; we may need an international degree verification for final checks. HR timeline?

People Ops Bot: Background checks: domestic degree verifications 2-4 business days; international verifications can take up to 15 business days. Recommend contingency in offer letter.

Clara Mendes: I'll reach out to interpreter vendors now and ask Facilities to reserve the greeter at South Lobby 9:45am. Also will tell candidate ACH only for reimbursements and request bank details after offer. Will update calendar with remote fallback link and interpreter contact.

Facilities: Greeter assigned: Sam O. Door sign and accessible entrance note will be posted. Interpreter vendor contacted; awaiting confirmation.

IT Support: Loaner W-721 held at concierge if needed. Imaging scheduled Fri 6pm.

People Ops Bot: Action items: (1) Facilities confirm interpreter onsite (2) Payroll await ACH details post-offer (3) IT image loaner W-721 (4) Recruiter send final itinerary including remote fallback. React with :thumbsup: when done.

Clara Mendes: Thanks all  I'll circulate final itinerary + interpreter confirmation by EOD.
